short_title: Paper Towel Holder Stand 14.4-Inch, Flat Troll Blue
description:
Keep paper towels within easy reach without using wall space—this freestanding paper towel holder keeps the roll upright and stable on your kitchen counter in Flat Troll Blue, which presents a distinctive, muted blue-gray tone that adds artistic character to contemporary kitchens designs.

Highlights:
- Flat Troll Blue creates a distinctive focal point
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
- Protect countertops from scuffs with a felt pad on the base
- Coordinate your kitchen with the Carolina Collection for a matching Carolina look across your hardware
- Built for everyday use from solid brass with a durable designer finish

Specs & Installation:
- Collection: Carolina (traditional/classic styling)
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Freestanding; no assembly required
- Overall size: 6.5 in L x 6.5 in W x 14.4 in H (projection 6.5 in)
- Weight capacity: 5 lb
- Product weight: 4 lb
- Included: Paper towel holder
Multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
